fullPassage: Between 1940 and 2000, Cuba ruled the world baseball scene. They won 25 of the first 28 World Cups and 3 of 5 Olympic Games. The Cubans were known for wearing uniforms covered in red from head to toe, a strong contrast to the more conservative North American style featuring grey or white pants. Not only were their athletic talents superior, the Cubans appeared even stronger from just the colour of their uniforms. A game would not even start and the opposing team would already be scared. A few years ago, Cuba altered that uniform style, modernizing it and perhaps conforming to other countries' style; interestingly, the national team has declined since that time. The country that ruled international baseball for decades has not been on top since that uniform change. Traditions are important for a team; while a team brand or image can adjust to keep up with present times, if it abandons or neglects its roots, negative effects can surface.

questions.passage: Between 1940 and 2000, Cuba ruled the world baseball scene. They won 25 of the first 28 World Cups and 3 of 5 Olympic Games. The Cubans were known for wearing uniforms covered in red <u>from head to toe</u>, a strong contrast to the more conservative North American style featuring grey or white pants. Not only were their athletic talents superior, the Cubans appeared even stronger from just the colour of their uniforms. A game would not even start and the opposing team would already be scared. A few years ago, Cuba altered that uniform style, modernizing it and perhaps conforming to other countries' style; interestingly, the national team has declined since that time. The country that ruled international baseball for decades has not been on top since that uniform change. Traditions are important for a team; while a team brand or image can adjust to keep up with present times, if it abandons or neglects its roots, negative effects can surface.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 from head to toe가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② from head to toe = 머리부터 발끝까지, 즉 전체가 빈틈없이
det.analysis:
❌ ① 머리와 발만: from head to toe는 일부가 아니라 '전체'를 뜻함
✅ ② 유니폼 전체가 빈틈없이 뒤덮인 상태: 'uniforms covered in red from head to toe'에서 from head to toe는 '머리부터 발끝까지=전체'를 뜻하는 관용표현으로, 유니폼 전체가 빨간색으로 뒤덮였음을 의미 ←정답
❌ ③ 선수들의 키: 신체 치수가 아니라 유니폼의 범위를 설명
❌ ④ 단련된 몸: 몸 상태가 아니라 유니폼이 덮인 범위를 설명
det.tip: from head to toe = 머리부터 발끝까지 = 전체(온통)

questions.passage: Between 1940 and 2000, Cuba ruled the world baseball scene. They won 25 of the first 28 World Cups and 3 of 5 Olympic Games. Not only were their athletic talents superior, the Cubans appeared even stronger from just the colour of their uniforms. A game would not even start and the opposing team would already be scared. A few years ago, Cuba altered that uniform style, modernizing it and perhaps conforming to other countries' style; interestingly, the national team has declined since that time. The country that ruled international baseball for decades has not been on top since that uniform change. Traditions are important for a team; while a team brand or image can adjust to keep up with present times, if it abandons or neglects <u>its</u> roots, negative effects can surface.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 its가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ its = 앞의 'a team(브랜드와 이미지를 가진 팀)'
det.analysis:
❌ ① 다른 나라 대표팀: its는 특정 다른 팀이 아니라 일반적인 '한 팀'을 가리킴
❌ ② 새 유니폼: its는 유니폼이 아니라 유니폼을 가진 팀을 지칭
✅ ③ 하나의 팀: 'a team brand or image can adjust ..., if it abandons or neglects its roots'에서 its는 앞의 a team을 받아 '팀의 뿌리'를 뜻함 ←정답
❌ ④ 국제 야구 대회: 대회가 아니라 팀을 가리킴
det.tip: a team ... if it abandons or neglects its roots → its = a team

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: negative effects can surface=부정적 영향이 나타날 수 있다 — 팀이 뿌리를 버리거나 소홀히 하면 생기는 결과
det.analysis:
✅ ① negative effects can surface(부정적 영향이 나타날 수 있다): 팀이 시대에 맞춰 변할 수는 있으나 뿌리를 버리면 부정적 영향이 생긴다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② the team instantly becomes world champion(즉시 세계 챔피언): 부정적 결과 맥락과 정반대
❌ ③ rival teams lose all their motivation(상대 팀이 동기를 잃음): 본문과 무관
❌ ④ the sport spreads rapidly worldwide(스포츠가 급속히 확산): 본문과 무관

questions.passage: A few years ago, Cuba altered that uniform style, modernizing it and perhaps __________ (conform) to other countries' style. The national team has declined since then.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 앞의 modernizing과 병렬되는 현재분사 conforming
det.analysis: 'modernizing it and perhaps __________ to other countries' style'에서 앞의 modernizing과 and로 병렬되는 분사가 필요하다. 동사 conform을 현재분사 conforming으로 바꾼다. conform → conforming
det.tip: 분사구문 병렬: modernizing ... and conforming to ~
